correctness.rationale: The conic is the unique degree-two component, so every projective stabilizer element restricts faithfully to it. Direct substitution into the quadratic parametrization identifies the six line factors with all six pairs of {0,infinity,1,-1}. Its cross-ratio is -1, whose Möbius stabilizer has exactly eight elements. Exact enumeration verifies the eight-element group and the dihedral relations, while line-line incidence recovers four conic vertices with three chords each and three opposite-chord nodes. No experimental step is used to infer an infinite statement: the only finite enumeration is the complete 24-permutation test for a four-point set.

value.rationale: The source highlights the arrangement as a free realization with weak combinatorics (3,0,4) and even displays it to convey symmetry, but does not determine that symmetry. The harmonic-chord interpretation is a structural explanation of both the exact order-eight isotropy and the 4-plus-3 singularity pattern. This is a natural exact invariant of a named classification example and places it at the harmonic symmetry-jump locus among four-point configurations on a conic, rather than merely recomputing a tabulated numerical invariant.
